_about: Every ability and passive mechanic in Slap City terms. Each row is one case in Gameplay/Mechanics.cs. Slow and stun use Slap City's own speed bonuses (SetBonusRunSpeed / SetBonusStateSpeed), so they work on any fighter.

columns.when: hit = when the move's hitbox connects; cast = when the move starts; passive = always on for the champion
columns.value: meaning of the number after the colon

rows.does: only the ability's dmg and kb multipliers apply
targets hit at the edge of the swing (farther than value units) take 50% more damage and heal the champion 4%
the target is launched back toward the champion instead of away
the target runs at 60% speed
the target is frozen in place (its moves run at 8% speed)
an airborne target is frozen in the air
knockback doubles when the target is at or above value damage %
damage goes up by value for each Hemorrhage stack on the target
damage is multiplied against airborne targets
a value chance to deal 60% more damage (plays the crit sound)
every third cast within 4 seconds launches straight up with more knockback
rows.value: knockback multiplier on the third cast

rows.does: each repeat cast within 3 seconds adds value to its damage (up to 4 stacks)
damage grows with the target's damage %: x(1 + target% / value)
value% of the damage dealt during the cast hits the targets again 3 seconds later
the champion slides forward as the move starts
the champion's damage % goes down by value
removes slows, stuns and bleeds from the champion
damage the champion takes is cut for 1.5 seconds
for value seconds the next hit is fully blocked; the attacker takes the ability's stun and 6% damage
projectiles that would hit the champion are blocked
the champion's next value hits deal 40% more damage
for 6 seconds the champion deals value times damage and every hit heals 3%
every hit adds a bleed stack (max 5, 5 s) dealing 0.5% per stack per second; at 5 stacks the champion gains Noxian Might: 30% more damage for 5 s
after 5 s without landing a hit, the next hit deals 50% more, burns the target (bleed-like, 3 s) and speeds the champion up for 2 s
moving fills Flow; when full, the next hit taken is cut by half
every second hit deals value times damage
when a fighter the champion hit in the last 3 s is knocked out, the champion runs value times faster for 4 s
every 4th hit on the same target strikes a vital: 40% more damage and heals value%
